img_414.description: Very coarse pixelation on beige parchment. In the centre a short horizontal red-brown shape, with a faint greyish-green horizontal smear just above it. No other detail can be made out.
img_414.central_figure: a small horizontal reddish shape, possibly a lying animal or an object; unclear
img_414.sign_reason: Only a red horizontal blob is visible; there are no legs, horns or other features that would decide a sign.

img_477.description: Pixelated. In the centre a red four-legged animal faces left, with a raised neck or head and a leg or tail at the right. It stands over a grey-brown block (possibly a painted-over patch) with small green marks near its head and below. Part of a dark brown disc shows at the left edge.
img_477.central_figure: a red quadruped, goat- or sheep-like, with a raised head
img_477.sign_reason: It is a red four-legged animal with an upright head, which suggests a ram or goat, but it could also be a bull (Taurus). No horn shape can be resolved.

img_617.description: Almost uniform beige parchment, heavily pixelated. One grey pixel and one small red dot appear, with very faint darker patches. No figure can be distinguished.

img_491.description: Pixelated beige ground with one small blue-green blob near the centre, roughly cross- or star-shaped, and a faint olive spot at the lower left.
img_491.central_figure: a small blue-green blob, perhaps a tiny figure or a star
img_491.sign_reason: The blob has no recognisable shape.

img_949.description: Pixelated. In the centre a dark olive-green shape like a shallow bowl or boat, wider at the top with upturned ends, sitting above a lighter brown rectangle (possibly a painted-over patch). There is a faint tan smudge above it.
img_949.central_figure: a dark green bowl- or boat-shaped object, possibly a crab-like body
img_949.sign_reason: A green crescent or bowl could be a crab body (Cancer) or a vessel, but no claws or legs are resolvable.

img_780.description: Pixelated. Near the centre an olive-brown elongated shape runs horizontally, with an angled projection at the left and a dark green blob further left (possibly a head). Below it is a lighter rectangle and a faint pale blue-green curve. Other faint smudges are scattered around.
img_780.central_figure: an olive-brown elongated shape, perhaps a four-legged animal or a lying figure with a green head
img_780.sign_reason: The outline suggests an animal but the species is not identifiable.

img_800.description: Almost featureless pixelated beige parchment with a few grey-blue pixels and a lighter rectangular area near the centre.

img_470.description: Pixelated. A faint circular border is visible around the edge, with greenish tints at the corners. Inside are two faint grey-brown horizontal elongated shapes, one above the other, with a pale blue-grey curve under the lower one.
img_470.central_figure: two faint horizontal elongated shapes, one above the other, possibly two fish
img_470.sign_reason: Two stacked horizontal elongated forms could be two fish, but they are very faint and could also be something else.

img_671.description: Pixelated beige ground. Faint blue-grey marks form a loose vertical figure: a curved blue stroke at the top with a tan patch below it (perhaps a head), a blue-grey mass in the middle and a small blue mark lower down.
img_671.central_figure: a faint bluish upright shape, possibly a human figure or an animal
img_671.sign_reason: The shape is too faint and broken to identify.

img_170.description: Pixelated. Around the image are scattered small coloured clusters (red and blue at the top, blue at the bottom, grey-blue at the right), possibly parts of surrounding figures. A faint green curved line arcs through the centre. There is no clear central figure.
img_170.central_figure: faint green curved lines with no clear subject; coloured fragments of surrounding figures

img_401.description: Pixelated. In the centre a faint pinkish-red four-legged shape faces left, with a raised part at the left and a small green blob near it. Faint red spots appear elsewhere (upper left, top, right), perhaps fragments of surrounding figures.
img_401.sign_reason: A reddish quadruped could be a ram, goat or bull; it is too faint to decide.

img_849.description: Pixelated. In the centre are two upright marks: on the left a pale olive-green curved form with a short green bar above it, and on the right a darker blue-green vertical form curving to the left at its foot. They stand side by side.
img_849.central_figure: two upright greenish and bluish forms side by side, possibly two standing figures
img_849.sign_reason: A pair of upright forms side by side could be the twins, but they are not clearly human.

recognise_source: Possibly. The style (red quadruped centre, circular diagrams, beige vellum, green/blue/red wash) is consistent with the zodiac medallions of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), but the images are too degraded to be sure.
